State Election
Commission
(Panchayati Raj)
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in provision
of ₹124.21 lakh was the net
effect of increase of
₹126.01 lakh and decrease
by re-appropriation of
₹1.80 lakh. Increase was
attributed to payment of
additional amounts in
medical allowances, salary,
subsistence allowances,
transport allowances, other
allowances, telephone, fuel
& hospitility expenditure
andmaintenanceofvehicle.
Decrease was attributed to
anticipated saving. Reasons
for final saving have not
been intimated (July 2024).
